udi: The serial number which is a component of the production identifier (PI), a conditional, variable portion of a UDI.   The identifier.type code should be set to “SNO”(Serial Number) and the system left empty.
The device identifier (DI), a mandatory, fixed portion of a UDI that identifies the labeler and the specific version or model of a device.

All UDIs are to be issued under a system operated by an Jurisdiction-accredited issuing agency.
